text:
Asha (Finance): Argent Data invoiced but it didn't route to approver — missing PO and tax code mismatch. Invoice INV-2026-089 for $12,345.67 shows Tax $0.00, PO expected tax 10% (~$1,234.57). Can AP help match or escalate?
Marco (AP): Looking into OCR results now. Invoice PDF missing a PO field, that's why auto-match failed.
Marco (AP): Quick check — vendor listed as 'Argent Data LLC' on PDF, our PO is under 'Argent Data Ltd'. Name mismatch might be the culprit.
Priya (Procurement): That vendor rebrand happened in Feb. PO 5432107 was issued in Jan under the old name. Likely the same PO.
Liam (Eng): Is this infra spend (which cost center) or an ad hoc consulting charge? Need to know routing for approvals.
Asha (Finance): It’s infra support — cost center "infra-svc", GL 5003. Attached snapshot of invoice header in the AP ticket.
Marco (AP): Created ticket AP-7841 and attached invoice PDF. I manually linked PO 5432107 to the ticket for tracking but payment is on hold pending tax reconciliation and approver sign-off.
Priya (Procurement): Who owns PO 5432107?
Priya (Procurement): @Ravi is listed as PO owner in the portal. Ravi — can you confirm and approve?
Ravi (Platform): I can approve the spend but we need tax corrected. Vendor shows tax 0% on invoice but the PO expected tax. We either need a corrected invoice or a CFO override for manual approval.
Asha (Finance): Per policy, tax mismatches > $1k require Finance Lead signoff for overrides. Tagging @Mina (Finance Lead) — please advise. :eyes:
Mina (Finance Lead): On it. Please upload the full PDF and short rationale into AP-7841. If vendor can't reissue immediately we can do a one-time override but will need a vendor attestation + GL memo.
InvoiceBot: Payment hold placed on INV-2026-089 (reason: PO mismatch / tax discrepancy).
Marco (AP): PDF uploaded to AP-7841, linked PO 5432107, added vendor name alias note. Pending Mina signoff.
Ravi (Platform): I'll notify the vendor's billing contact and request a corrected invoice with PO# 5432107 and tax applied. If they can't reissue within 48h, I'll sign off for engineering contingent on Finance approval.
Asha (Finance): Noted. Keeping this thread open until Mina confirms. Will move to resolved once either corrected invoice received or override executed with docs.
Mina (Finance Lead): Reviewing now. If I approve, I'll post the CFO approval note to AP-7841.
Marco (AP): Thanks — marking status: awaiting Finance Lead. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
